mentions.name: HN-like (meta)science discussion forum (talk.amacrin.com)
mentions.description: A Hacker News-style discussion forum dedicated to (meta)science, offering a centralized place for deeper, casual discussions on the topic. It is currently fully open for signup, with possible plans to switch to user-invite-only and move to its own domain once a better name is chosen.
mentions.problem: Most (meta)science discussion is either fragmented on Twitter/Bsky, or a bit too formal.
mentions.audience: Metascience researchers and others interested in deeper, casual (meta)science discussions.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I made a HN-like discussion forum for (meta)science.

https://talk.amacrin.com/

Most (meta)science discussion is either fragmented on Twitter/Bsky, or a bit too formal. I thought a centralised place for deeper, casual discussions might be helpful, so I'm testing that theory.
